Job Description: Providing for loved ones, planning rewarding retirements, saving enough for whatever lies ahead – our policyholders count on us to be there when it matters most. It’s a big ask, but it’s one that we have the power to deliver when we work together.

We collaborate and innovate – pushing one another to transform not just Pacific Life , but the entire industry for the better. Why? Because it’s the right thing to do. Pacific Life is more than a job, it’s a career with purpose.

It’s a career where you have the support, balance, and resources to make a positive impact on the future – including your own. Pacific Life is seeking a skilled sales professional to support the growth of Broker Distribution within the Workforce Benefits organization.

You will play an integral part in Pacific Life ’s efforts to establish and grow a $1B revenue, profitable business in the Workforce Benefits market. This role is considered to be 100% remote, as travel is required, and our ideal candidate for this role will be based in the Maryland or DC marketplace .

As Workforce Benefits Sales Consultant - Broker Distribution you’ll play a key role in the startup and long-term success of this business by working with leaders in the Workforce Benefits division to meet established goals and objectives.

Your focus will be on building relationships, developing and executing broker specific strategies and driving growth toward sales goals within the Broker Distribution Channel. You are responsible for bringing our business to the broker market and meeting annual metrics-based sales objectives.

The role will align with other Workforce Benefits Distribution resources to educate the Broker and GA marketplace around Pacific Life ’s Group Benefits value proposition and meet collective sales goals. You will report directly to the RSM of Broker Distribution.

How You'll Help Move Us Forward Support the creation and execution of a strategy for Broker Distribution that helps meet new sales, retention, profitability and expense objectives. Meet annual sales goals as established by the RSM of Broker Distribution.

Partner with Workforce Benefits Distribution resources to deliver the Workforce Benefits story to the broker community. Continually work to strengthen, deepen, and grow broker relationships. Execute appropriate number of broker meetings per week with assigned brokers. Drive a pipeline of appropriate number of RFP’s per month.

Build and advance local broker relationships to drive sales and increase the Pacific Life brand in your market. Demonstrate proficiency in the group products sold by Pacific Life .

Maintain strong connections with underwriting, product, pricing, regulatory compliance, and actuarial pricing teams to ensure alignment on critical deliverables with your broker relationships. Utilize established and innovative approaches, tools and partners to enable efficient, deliberate and robust growth objectives.

Bring a customer-first mindset: prioritize customer and broker viewpoints in decision-making. Participate in ongoing industry and community activities to stay attuned to industry trends. Represent the company as needed with legislative platforms, industry events, community activities. Perform other job-related duties or special projects as required.

The Experience You Bring 5+ years’ experience in group benefits sales with an established presence in the broker marketplace College degree with concentration in business management, finance, or risk management or equivalent work experience is required.

The inclination to seek and analyze data from a variety of sources to support decisions and to align others with the organization's overall strategy. An entrepreneurial and creative approach to developing new, innovative ideas that will stretch the organization and push the boundaries within the industry.

Ability to seek opinions of others, process feedback and take smart risks. A high degree of integrity and able to act in a transparent and consistent manner while always taking into account what is best for the organization.

Self-reflective and aware of his/her own limitations; leads by example and drives the organization's performance with an attitude of continuous improvement. Mindset to enable breakthrough innovations and business models that create value for all stakeholders, continually challenging traditional approaches.

What Makes You Stand Out Strong performance orientation and drive for results. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to grasp complexities and perceive relationships among business and financial issues. Known for ability to respectfully and confidently collaborate and easily communicate with various stakeholders.

Compensation: The base salary for this position is $75,000. In addition, this role is eligible for incentives based on sales performance. You can be who you are. We are committed to a culture of diversity and inclusion that embraces the authenticity of all employees, partners and communities.

We support all employees to thrive and achieve their fullest potential. What’s life like at Pacific Life ? Visit Instagram.com/lifeatpacificlife Base Pay Range: The base pay range noted represents the company’s good faith minimum and maximum range for this role at the time of posting.

The actual compensation offered to a candidate will be dependent upon several factors, including but not limited to experience, qualifications and geographic location. Also, most employees are eligible for additional incentive pay.

Your Benefits Start Day 1 Your wellbeing is important to Pacific Life , and we’re committed to providing you with flexible benefits that you can tailor to meet your needs. Whether you are focusing on your physical, financial, emotional, or social wellbeing, we’ve got you covered.

Prioritization of your health and well-being including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Wellbeing Reimbursement Account that can be used on yourself or your eligible dependents Generous paid time off options including: Paid Time Off, Holiday Schedules, and Financial Planning Time Off Paid Parental Leave as well as an Adoption Assistance Program Competitive 401k savings plan with company match and an additional contribution regardless of participation You Can Be Who You Are We are committed to a culture of diversity and inclusion that embraces the authenticity of all employees, partners and communities.

We support all employees to thrive and achieve their fullest potential. What’s life like at Pacific Life ? Visit Instagram.com/lifeatpacificlife EEO Statement: Pacific Life Insurance Company is an Equal Opportunity /Affirmative Action Employer, M/F/D/V.

At Ecolab, we help make the world cleaner, safer and healthier .
Ecolab is a trusted partner at nearly three million customer locations in more than 170 countries and a global leader in water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions. We combine complete solutions, data‑driven insights and personalised service to help customers improve food safety, maintain safe environments, optimise water and energy use, and drive sustainable performance across food, healthcare, hospitality and industrial sectors.
If you are early in your career and looking to learn, grow and make a real impact, our Territory Manager in Training Programme could be the right next step.
About the Programme
This is a 12 month, structured development programme designed to prepare you for a future role as a Territory Manager. Starting from October 1st, 2026 you will be supported every step of the way through a combination of:
Classroom and virtual learning
On‑the‑job training and job shadowing
Coaching from experienced colleagues
Hands‑on experience with customers in real environments
From day one you’ll gain exposure to customer operations, learn how to diagnose challenges, and develop practical solutions that improve safety, hygiene and sustainability.
About the Division
Within the Water division (Nalco Water, an Ecolab company), Ecolab delivers water treatment, process and digital water management solutions to help customers improve operational performance, protect critical assets and advance sustainability goals. Our solutions support customers across industrial, manufacturing, food and beverage processing, power generation, energy, mining, data-centers and commercial facilities, from water intake through reuse and discharge.

After completing your training, you will take ownership of an established customer territory, becoming a trusted partner and technical advisor to your customers. You will provide expert guidance on water treatment, process optimisation and digital water management programs that help improve operational performance, protect critical assets and support safe, efficient and sustainable customer operations.

Build strong, trusted relationships with existing customers through regular service visits
Learn how customers’ systems work, gaining hands-on experience with equipment, technologies and solutions used in their daily operations
Support the installation, maintenance and safe use of equipment, helping customers keep their facilities fully operational
Train and support customer teams, making sure they feel confident using Ecolab solutions
Gradually develop the ability to spot improvement opportunities, deliver technical demonstrations and support the growth of your assigned territory
Work closely with colleagues across different teams (Sales, Marketing Services, Customer Service) to deliver the best possible customer experience
Contribute to Ecolab’s growth by supporting outreach activities and helping build our brand in your local market
What you’ll need?
We are interested in meeting individuals with diverse backgrounds. You may be a great fit if you:
Have completed technical / scientific education (Ideally in Chemical Engineering or Chemistry)
Are interested in building a career in technical, sales or service-related roles
Are eager to learn, open to feedback and motivated to continuously develop new skills
Have demonstrated problem solving skills and creative thinking
Are comfortable adapting to new situations and challenges
Have basic IT skills (Microsoft Office)
Have at least a B1 level in English
Hold a valid driver’s license, with an acceptable Motor Vehicle Record, and are open to traveling within your assigned district and occasionally nationwide
No Immigration Sponsorship available

A 12month fixed-term contract, that may lead to a permanent position, depending on business needs
A robust, structured training programme, that includes job shadowing, e-learning modules, structured field activities, and customized classroom style training, with clear development milestones
A supportive environment where coaching and feedback are part of everyday work, allowing you to learn from subject matter experts with proven success
The opportunity to carve out a long term, advanced career path in sales, within a business that recognises the talent to progress
25 days holiday plus 8 days Bank Holiday

If you've done outbound for a while, you know what most SDR roles actually look like: a number on a board, a script to follow, and meetings that get booked whether they're ready or not. We built this role differently.
Our SDRs spend 15 to 30 minutes on a qualifying call. Not to pitch, but to actually understand what's broken in a prospect's business and whether it's worth an AE's time. We call it a pain chain: symptom, root cause, business cost. And: No chain, no meeting; the AE will send it back for further qualification. It keeps the quality honest and it means the work you do actually matters downstream. If you're ready to trade volume for something with more substance, it's worth a conversation.
🎯 What you’ll own
Your accounts are mid-market and enterprise (150-5,000 employees). You run the full qualification process before anything reaches an AE, which in practice looks like this:
Qualification calls that go long enough to build a real case, not just confirm that someone picked up
Re-engagement on accounts that have been approached before, with a genuine plan for how to get in differently
Follow-up calls with yourself when a first conversation doesn't go deep enough, rather than booking something that isn't ready
Finding your own contacts when the data isn't clean, because it often isn't
Keeping HubSpot honest so your pipeline reflects reality
Working closely enough with your AE that what you hand off actually lands

You've done B2B outbound before and you have a real opinion on what makes a qualification call worth something. That's the baseline.
1-2 years of outbound sales or SDR experience in B2B
You've worked accounts with no clean data, navigated gatekeepers, and made multi-touch sequences actually work
You think about pipeline quality, not just volume, and you can explain the difference to someone who disagrees
Fluent German, working English
You manage your own day well and take feedback seriously when it comes
🤩 What's different here
The qualification bar here is genuinely high. A meeting without a clear pain chain doesn't move forward, and you're expected to know that before it reaches the AE. There's no hiding behind dial counts or activity metrics when the pipeline tells a different story.
The accounts you'll work aren't easy. No clean contact data, gatekeepers who've heard every opener, prospects who need a few different approaches before they pick up. The job isn't to call more. It's to find the angle that works, and to keep looking until you do.
When it clicks, you feel it. Your pipeline moves, your meetings convert, and the AE comes back wanting more. People here have moved to AE in around 24 months. That track is real, and it starts with the quality of what you build in this role.
🚀 Why doinstruct
You'll get coaching from Jiri (one of Germany's top sales trainers) alongside day-to-day feedback from an SDR lead who's genuinely among the best in the country
The SDR team has real influence on how we approach markets. You're not just running someone else's sequences
We're honest about what's working and what isn't, in both directions
400+ customers, Series A funded, below 2% churn. The product is a genuine must-have, which makes the conversation easier

About vCluster Labs

We are the leading platform for operating GPU infrastructure, enabling AI Cloud providers to deliver a hyperscaler-like experience to their customers and AI factories that need to build that same experience for their internal teams.

Our platform delivers the full operational stack operators need to run their GPU data centers — managed Kubernetes, fast isolated tenant provisioning, and automated node provisioning and lifecycle management — enabling them to accelerate time to value, reduce operational burden, and maximize the ROI of every GPU.
We're the company behind vCluster, an open-source technology for virtualizing Kubernetes (10k+ GitHub stars, 40M+ virtual clusters created since 2021). Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI — a Kubernetes-native framework purpose-built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

s.h: We're looking for Business Development Representatives
s.t:
We’re building a new insurance business from the ground up to protect SMEs, and we’re looking for Business Development Representatives to join our team. If you’re a high-energy communicator who loves building relationships and wants to gain experience, qualifications, and career progression at a leading fintech, apply now.
The company
We're here because we believe in SMEs. We believe they deserve better than confusing jargon, slow and outdated customer experiences, and being caught out by hidden conditions and fees. And we believe it's our job to help them navigate risk with confidence.
Since 2012, iwoca has made finance fast, flexible, and fair for over 150,000 businesses. Now, we're doing the same for insurance. We're building a brand new insurance business from the ground up — to protect SMEs in the moments that matter most.
Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed by providing access to better finance and services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team is a small, entrepreneurial group responsible for launching iwoca's new SME insurance business. Here’s how the team work together:
Customer-obsessed: The team challenges itself to build insurance that its customers actually want, rather than what insurers simply want to sell.
Curious & supportive: The team collaborates across disciplines to find creative solutions to complex problems in a safe and supportive environment.
Move fast & have fun: The team is fast-paced and highly autonomous, but makes sure to celebrate wins and have fun along the way.
Ambitious & entrepreneurial: The environment is ideal for people who thrive on taking ownership of their work and are ready to roll up their sleeves and build.

You’ll be the person introducing our new insurance offering to businesses who are tired of the status quo. You’ll help SMEs move away from complicated, slow insurance policies and make them aware of a fairer, more transparent way to protect their business.

Proactively engage with SME business operators by phone ahead of their business insurance renewal date to offer a better alternative.
Master the art of the pitch—navigating gatekeepers, articulating our value proposition, and turning objections into opportunities for our brokers to help them.
Manage your pipeline end-to-end within our HubSpot CRM, ensuring meticulous record-keeping and proactive follow-ups so that no opportunity is missed.
Collaborate closely with our in-house brokers and wider team to turn early customer feedback into insights that refine our product offering and sales strategy.

Previous experience navigating outbound or client-facing interactions within a professional business environment.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to build rapport, influence decisions, and handle commercial objections over the phone and email.
A high-energy, resilient, and results-oriented personality that thrives on achieving goals. You have sharp problem-solving instincts and a "can-do" mindset.
Organised and proactive approach to managing your workload.
Ability to adapt and excel in a fast-moving, high-growth atmosphere.
Eagerness to learn - insurance industry experience isn’t necessary - we will provide training to help you succeed.
A desire to secure professional qualifications and drive long-term career progression within a rapidly scaling fintech environment

We expect to pay around £30,000 plus bonus for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.
The culture
At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the professional development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage you to explore new areas of interest to help us innovate and improve our products and services.
The offices

s.h: We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work
s.t:
Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.
Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

Flexible working hours.
Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.
A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.
25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.
A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.
Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.
3% Pension contributions on total earnings.
An employee equity incentive scheme.
Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.
Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.
Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

s.t:

Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.
Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

At David Zwirner, we look to be an industry leader in our field, with our artists at the center of what we do. Our global exhibition program expands beyond our locations in New York, London, Los Angeles, Hong Kong, and Paris, representing over seventy artists and estates.

Home to innovative, singular, and pioneering exhibitions across a variety of media and genres. Active in both the primary and secondary markets, David Zwirner has helped foster the careers of some of the most influential artists today.

s.h: Who will work well with us
s.t:
The ideal candidate is someone who is passionate and interested in the arts/larger creative arena or is eager to learn.
We welcome all individuals entering the workforce, those moving into a new stage of their career or vocation, making a change, returning to work, and those wanting to learn and grow within the industry, to apply.
About the Opportunity
Sales Assistant to Senior Partner
David Zwirner seeks a full-time Sales Assistant to work alongside one of the gallery's Senior Partners. The Sales Assistant will fulfill administrative assistant duties as well as liaise with curators, artists, and clients for the Senior Partner.
Superior writing skills, the ability to time manage and meet deadlines, and a thorough working knowledge of contemporary art are required. This position will involve significant contact with artists and long time clients and other art industry professionals therefore discretion and poise are essential. This position may be scheduled Mondays - Fridays or Tuesdays - Saturdays depending on gallery needs.
Candidates must be diligent, extremely organized, and possess excellent time management and communication skills.

s.h: Support Senior Partner with roster of artists

More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency.

Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.
Company Operating Rhythm
At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.
Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.
Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Business Development Representative
Turn strong, growing inbound demand into qualified pipeline — supported by targeted ABX outbound and the industry’s biggest events
There are a lot of security companies out there, but no one is doing what Nucleus is doing: giving security teams the ability to run the most effective vulnerability and exposure management program possible. Some of the largest enterprises and government agencies in the world run on our platform, and we’re growing fast. Top-tier venture funding, an amazing team who will fight beside you to accomplish the impossible, great benefits, and fully remote.
Here’s the good news about this seat: our inbound demand is strong and growing. Your primary job is to work it well — respond fast, qualify sharply, and turn real interest into meetings your AE counterparts are glad to take. You’ll back that up with targeted outbound into named accounts as part of our account-based (ABX) program, and you’ll represent Nucleus face to face at the industry’s biggest security events a few times a year.
Why this role exists
This is a new seat created by growth — driven in large part by inbound volume we want to convert better and faster. Your individual output is visible and it matters. You’ll also be joining a leader whose real strength is developing top-performing BDRs: structured onboarding, weekly coaching and mock calls, and a documented track record of promoting reps into account executive, solutions engineering, customer success, and marketing roles.

Own inbound — this is the priority. Be the first, fast, credible response to the people raising their hands: demo requests, content and webinar leads, event follow-up, and trial interest. Qualify with real discovery — need, timing, environment, decision process — and convert genuine interest into meetings that stick. Speed and judgment both matter: our buyers are busy, and the first good conversation usually wins.
Support the ABX program with targeted outbound. Outbound here is deliberate, not a numbers game. You’ll work a defined set of high-value named accounts alongside Marketing and your AEs — using intent and account signals to time your outreach — so outbound reinforces the accounts we’ve collectively decided matter most.
Personalize everything, and use AI to do it well. Our buyers are technical and busy. You’ll write outreach and follow-up that sounds like a person who understands their world — and you’ll use AI tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) every day to research faster and sharpen your messaging.
Run a clean process. Manage inbound routing, accounts, and follow-up in Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Outreach, and Gong — and partner closely with your AEs and Marketing to act on campaign signals fast.
Represent Nucleus at our biggest events. A few times a year, our BDRs are the front line at RSAC, Black Hat, the Gartner Security & Risk Management Summit, and other key events — proactively engaging people in and around our booth, qualifying on the spot, and booking high-quality meetings. Expect roughly 3–4 events a year, plus our annual company and sales kickoff.
Your first 90 days
We’ve run this playbook before, and we don’t leave ramp to chance:
First 30 days
By 60 days
By 90 days
Structured onboarding and product training. Learn our market, ICP, and the vulnerability and exposure management problems our buyers face. Shadow calls, run mock calls, and start handling live inbound with close coaching.
Owning inbound response and qualification for your patch, with outbound sequences live into your named ABX accounts. Weekly 1:1s and email-writing sessions to sharpen your craft.
Fully ramped and holding your own number — converting inbound into qualified meetings, supporting ABX outbound, and confident enough in the material to represent Nucleus in front of a security buyer.

2–4+ years in sales or business development — BDR/SDR, inside sales, or another customer-facing role. Experience handling real inbound volume with a high qualification bar is especially relevant.
Sharp qualification instincts. You can tell a genuine opportunity from a tire-kicker quickly, and you protect your AEs’ calendars without dropping real interest on the floor.
Outbound capability too. You can build and run a thoughtful, targeted sequence into a named account when it matters — not just work a queue.
Cybersecurity or technical SaaS experience preferred. Holding a credible conversation with a security buyer is a meaningful advantage.
Strong communication. Concise and credible in writing and on the phone with senior technical people.
Comfortable in person. You genuinely enjoy meeting people face to face and can open a conversation with a stranger on a busy expo floor.
AI-fluent. Using AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, and Claude in your daily workflow is a requirement, not a bonus.
Tech-savvy. Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Gong, Slack, Teams, and Zoom.
Curious, resilient, and coachable. You want to be coached — this is a team where you’ll get real feedback and be expected to use it.
Nice to have: selling into U.S. Federal, Defense, or State & Local government; an established cybersecurity network; a bachelor’s or associate degree.
If you have less experience than the range above but can show real results and genuine curiosity about security, we’d still like to hear from you. We hire for trajectory and coachability, not just years on a resume.
Why you should be excited
The mission. We automate enterprise vulnerability and exposure management so security teams can prioritize and mitigate risk, at scale — working toward a world where remediation outpaces exploitation.
Warm demand to work with. You’re not starting from zero. Inbound interest is real and growing, and your job is to make the most of it.
The career path. A launchpad, run by a leader who builds and promotes top performers into AE, solutions engineering, customer success, and marketing roles.
Nucleus believes “work is people”, and when our people succeed, our company succeeds.

Als **Tierarztberater/in (Vet Advisor)** bei Purina besteht Ihre Mission darin, eine veterinärmedizinische Fürsprache und Empfehlung für die Sortimente Pro Plan Veterinary und Pro Plan Maintenance aufzubauen.

* Aufbau vertrauensvoller Beziehungen zu Tierärztinnen und Tierärzten, um die Empfehlung und Nutzung der Purina Pro Plan Sortimente nachhaltig zu stärken.

* Identifikation und Priorisierung von Chancen innerhalb des Gebiets, um den größtmöglichen Mehrwert für Tiergesundheit und Geschäftserfolg zu schaffen.
* Entwicklung gemeinsamer Erfolgspläne mit Tierarztpraxen, Meinungsbildnern und relevanten Stakeholdern zur Förderung nachhaltiger Partnerschaften.
* Nutzung von Markt- und Kundeninsights zur kontinuierlichen Optimierung von Aktivitäten und Ergebnissen.
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Commercial-, Marketing- und weiteren funktionsübergreifenden Teams zur Förderung von Wachstum und Kundenerfolg.
**Das macht Sie erfolgreich**
* Fundiertes wissenschaftliches Verständnis sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe veterinärmedizinische Inhalte verständlich und praxisnah zu vermitteln.
* Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten, um Tierärztinnen und Tierärzte zu begeistern und zu überzeugen.
* Strukturierte Herangehensweise an Gebietsplanung, um Chancen zu erkennen und Prioritäten wirkungsvoll zu setzen.
* Erfahrung in der funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit sowie ein datenorientierter Ansatz, um Kundenbeziehungen und Ergebnisse kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
* Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr gute Englisch- oder Französischkenntnisse.
* Leidenschaft für Haustiergesundheit und Interesse an Tierernährung; Kenntnisse im Bereich Heimtierernährung sind ein Plus.
**Bei Purina finden Sie eine Welt, in der Ihre Fähigkeiten, Ihr Wissen und Ihre Leidenschaft wachsen können.**
Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges und ausgewogenes Leistungspaket, das Ihr Wachstum und Ihr Wohlbefinden bei der Arbeit und im Leben unterstützt:
* Flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten
* Bezahlte Urlaubstage über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus
* Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere voranzubringen
* Leistungsbezogener Bonus
* Beitrag an die Gesundheitskosten und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program
* Starker Arbeitgeberbeitrag an Ihren Pensionskassenplan
* Grosszügiger Elternurlaub und umfassende Unterstützungsangebote für Familien
* Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte auf verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen
**Was Sie in unserem Recruiting Prozess erwartet**
Nestlé ist ein inklusiver Arbeitgeber. Falls erforderlich, stellen wir Ihnen während Ihres Bewerbungsprozesses gerne angemessene Unterstützung bereit. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.
Unser Arbeitsplatz ist vollständig barrierefrei, mit stufenlosem Zugang, Aufzügen zu allen Etagen und barrierefreien Toiletten. Zudem pflegen wir eine ausgeprägte Sicherheitskultur, unterstützt durch moderne Anlagen und Verfahren, um für alle ein sicheres Umfeld zu gewährleisten.
Unser Bewerbungsprozess umfasst in der Regel eine Sichtung der Unterlagen, ein Video-Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Gespräch mit dem Hiring Team sowie ein abschliessendes Gespräch und Angebot. Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und werden Sie Teil einer Bewegung, die eine bessere Welt für Haustiere und Menschen schafft.

Dein Impact Du baust die Outbound Engine, die autarc in die nächste Wachstumsphase bringt. Als Senior Sales Development Lead verantwortest du unsere Outbound-Pipeline.

Du verbindest Strategie mit täglicher Umsetzung: die richtigen Zielgruppen identifizieren, starke Ansprache entwickeln, Menschen besser machen und aus guten Gesprächen verlässlich neue Sales-Chancen schaffen. Dabei gehst du selbst ans Telefon, testest neue Ansätze und setzt den Standard für dein Team.

Dich erwarten hohes Tempo, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und direkte Verantwortung für unser Wachstum.
Standort: Berlin
Outbound-Pipeline verantworten: Du verantwortest den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Outbound-Pipeline – von der Auswahl passender Accounts über die Erstansprache bis zur qualifizierten Übergabe an unser Sales Team.
Selbst vorangehen: Du bist als Player-Coach aktiv in der Akquise. Du führst selbst Cold Calls, testest Gesprächseinstiege und Einwandbehandlung und zeigst deinem Team, wie aus einem ersten Kontakt eine echte Sales-Chance wird.
Outbound-Strategie entwickeln: Du legst fest, welche Zielgruppen wir mit welchen Botschaften über welche Kanäle erreichen. Cold Calling ist der Kern, ergänzt durch weitere Kontaktpunkte wie LinkedIn, E-Mail und Messen.
Neue ICPs und Personas erschließen: Gemeinsam mit unserem GTM-Team entwickelst und validierst du neue ideale Kundenprofile und Buyer Personas. Du priorisierst Segmente und findest heraus, wo wir wiederholbar qualifizierte Pipeline aufbauen können.
Prozesse und Playbooks aufbauen: Du entwickelst klare Standards für Recherche, Ansprache, Follow-ups, Qualifizierung und Übergabe. Erfolgreiche Ansätze übersetzt du in Playbooks, die das gesamte Team im Alltag nutzen kann.
Performance steuern: Du definierst gemeinsam mit Sales klare Ziele und steuerst das Team anhand relevanter Kennzahlen – von erreichten Entscheidern und qualifizierten Terminen bis zu akzeptierten Sales-Chancen und generierter Pipeline. Du erkennst Engpässe und leitest konkrete Verbesserungen ab.
Tools und Daten nutzbar machen: Du sorgst für saubere CRM-Daten, transparente Reports und einen sinnvollen Einsatz unserer Sales-Tools. Dein Team soll seine Zeit in gute Gespräche investieren können.
Hiring und Onboarding mitgestalten: Du hilfst uns, weitere Talente zu gewinnen, und entwickelst ein strukturiertes Onboarding, mit dem neue Teammitglieder schnell produktiv werden.
Eng mit GTM, Sales und Produkt arbeiten: Du stellst sicher, dass aus dem Feedback deiner Gespräche bessere Botschaften, eine präzisere Positionierung und wertvolle Impulse für unsere Software entstehen.
Requirements Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Outbound-Vertrieb mit, idealerweise in einem SaaS- oder Technologieunternehmen, und hast nachweislich qualifizierte Pipeline aufgebaut.
Du hast bereits ein SDR-, BDR- oder Outbound-Team geführt oder als Senior im Team konkrete Verantwortung für Coaching, Onboarding und gemeinsame Ergebnisse übernommen.
Du beherrschst Cold Calling aus eigener Praxis. Du kannst gute Gespräche selbst führen und anderen verständlich vermitteln, was sie erfolgreich macht.
Du weißt, wie man aus einzelnen erfolgreichen Vertriebsaktivitäten einen verlässlichen Prozess entwickelt – mit klaren Zielgruppen, relevanter Ansprache und konsequenten Follow-ups.
Du kannst Leistung einfordern und Menschen dabei unterstützen, sie zu erreichen. Du gibst direktes, konstruktives Feedback und schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem dein Team Verantwortung übernimmt.
Du arbeitest strukturiert und datenbasiert. Du erkennst, ob ein Engpass bei der Aktivität, Erreichbarkeit, Gesprächsqualität oder Qualifizierung liegt, und setzt dort an.
Du fühlst dich in einem schnell wachsenden Startup wohl, triffst Entscheidungen und bringst neue Ideen zügig in die Umsetzung.
Du gehst sicher mit HubSpot oder einem vergleichbaren CRM um und hast Erfahrung mit gängigen Outbound- und Lead-Generation-Tools.
Du begeisterst dich für die Transformation der Energiebranche und möchtest mit deinem Team innovative Software im Handwerk etablieren.
Du sprichst fließend Deutsch.

Echte Verantwortung: Übernimm eigenständig die Verantwortung für deine Aufgabenpakete innerhalb eines schnell wachsenden Startups.

Büro in Berlin-Mitte: Unser Büro liegt in der Nähe des Weinbergsparks in Berlin-Mitte.
Modernes Equipment: MacBook und 27” Bildschirm. Du hast die Freiheit, dein eigenes Equipment auszuwählen.
Jährliches Team-Retreat: Teilnahme an einem jährlichen Retreat mit dem gesamten Team.
Mobilitätspaket: Wähle zwischen einem JobRad und Dance Bike für deine Mobilität.
Fitnesspaket: Entscheide dich zwischen Urban Sports und Classpass für deine Fitness.
Kollegiales und familiäres Team: Ein kollegiales und familiäres Team heißt dich willkommen, geprägt von einer offenen Unternehmenskultur.
Teil der Energiewende: Sei ein Teil der Energiewende und erlebe den Impact deiner täglichen Arbeit direkt.

Möchten Sie sich Ihre Zukunft selber ausmalen? Dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig: "Mis Spital. Mini Usbildig". Wir freuen uns auf Sie.
## Aufgaben ##
Sie lernen den Akutbereich kennen sowie die Aufgaben einer Pflegefachfrau/-mann auszuüben. Sie lernen den Pflegeprozess der Patient\*innen zu planen und lernen, was es heisst, für die Pflege verantwortlich zu sein. Sie unterstützen die Patient\*innen bei den Aktivitäten des täglichen Lebens.

Dazu gehören Organisation, Planung sowie medizinaltechnische und administrative Arbeiten. Zudem arbeiteten Sie eng mit anderen Berufsgruppen zusammen, mit dem Ziel, gemeinsam die beste Behandlung für unsere Patient\*innen sicherzustellen.

Sie sind Teil eines lebhaften und dynamischen Teams, das Sie stets unterstützt, das Erlernte erfolgreich in die Praxis umzusetzen.
## Profil ##
* Abgeschlossene dreijährige Berufslehre EFZ oder DMS-/FMS-Abschluss oder gymnasiale Matur
* Eignungsverfahren des Bildungszentrums Careum oder ZAG
* Gute Deutschkenntnisse und kommunikative Fähigkeiten sowie Freude am Umgang mit Menschen
* Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Entscheidungsfähigkeit und Reflexionsfähigkeit
* Lernbereitschaft und Motivation, sich für ihre Ausbildung einzusetzen
* Interesse am Gesundheitswesen und an der Arbeit in einem Spital
## Wir bieten ##
* vielfältige Ausbildung und Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Teams
* Teamzugehörigkeit und individuelle Ausbildungsbegleitung durch Berufsbildner\*innen und Lehrpersonen
* Einsätze in verschiedenen medizinischen Kliniken (z.B. Medizin, Chirurgie usw.)
* Individueller Einzelunterricht im Praxisalltag
* Einblickstage z.B. in die Bereiche Anästhesie, Intensivstation und Notfall
* LTT (Lernbereich Training und Transfer) mit externen und internen Expert\*innen

## Vorstudien- oder Ausbildungspraktikant\*innen (80%) ##
Die Sonnegg ist eine gemeinnützige Institution mit Leistungsverträgen des Bundes und des Kantons Bern.

Unser Angebot unterstützt normal begabte junge Frauen\* im Alter zwischen 14 und 18 Jahren, die aufgrund unterschiedlicher Verhaltensauffälligkeiten und Persönlichkeitsentwicklungsstörungen einen hohen Unterstützungsbedarf sowie Schulabsentismus aufweisen.

Zu deren Begleitung hat die Sonnegg im Sinne eines Alleinstellungsmerkmals ein spezialisiertes, gut aufeinander abgestimmtes interdisziplinäres Setting (Wohnen-Schule-Therapie) entwickelt. Ziel dabei ist, die jungen Frauen\* bestmöglich für ihre persönliche und berufliche Verselbstständigung vorzubereiten.

Die Sonnegg arbeitet nach der Methodik «KOSS»/ Kitty Cassée sowie auf Basis der «Gewaltfreien Kommunikation»/ M. Rosenberg und vertritt eine traumasensible Haltung.
Was sind Ihre Aufgaben?
* Begleitung von 6 jungen Frauen\* im Wohngruppenalltag
* Mitgestaltung von Freizeitangeboten für die jungen Frauen\*
* alltägliche Haushaltsarbeiten (Einkaufen, Kochen, Ämtli etc.)
* gemeinsame Übernahme von verschiedenen Diensten (Tag-, Abend, Wochenend-, Ferien und allenfalls Nachtpikettdienste)
* Teilnahme und Mitgestaltung von Gruppensitzungen, Gruppentagen, Sonnegg-Anlässen, Gruppenausflügen, Gruppenübergreifenden Ausflügen etc.
* administrative Arbeiten (Journalführung, Protokolle verfassen)
Was bringen Sie mit?
* Sie organisieren und unternehmen gerne Freizeitangebote für und mit den jungen Frauen\*.
* Sie verfügen über grundlegende administrative Fähigkeiten und EDV-Kenntnisse.
* Sie übernehmen gerne Verantwortung.
* Sie sind mind. 25 Jahre alt.
* Sie schätzen unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten und freie Tage unter der Woche.
* Sie sind daran interessiert, die Methodik «KOSS» kennenzulernen.
* Sie möchten sich mit den vielfältigen Themen in der Adoleszenz auseinandersetzen.
* Sie sind flexibel und belastbar.
* Sie interessieren sich für genderspezifische Themen.
* Sie sind am guten Grund hinter jedem Verhalten der jungen Frauen\*interessiert.
Was bieten wir?
* sorgfältige Einarbeitung und fachliche Unterstützung
* aussergewöhnliche sozialpädagogische Aufgabe, bei der Ihr Beziehungsangebot eine der tragenden Säulen für die persönliche Entwicklung der jungen Frauen\* darstellt
* Möglichkeit, eigene Interessen und Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten einzubringen
* Interdisziplinarität auf Augenhöhe (Wohnen, Schule, Therapie)
* regelmässige PA-Gespräche sowie Austauschgefässe unter den Studierenden
* div. interne Gefässe (sozialpädagogisches Forum, KOSS-Einführung, Gesamtforum, interdisziplinäre Fallbesprechung, psychiatrische Fallbesprechungen, Supervision sowie interne Weiterbildung),
* Anstellungsbedingungen nach Kantonalen Richtlinien des Kantons Bern
* während der Schulwochen notwendige Überzeit wird während der Schulferien kompensiert, d.h. in der Regel 8 arbeitsfreie Wochen / Jahr
* Wochenenddienste werden zwischen den drei Wohngruppen rotiert
* während dem Dienst Mahlzeiten auf der Wohngruppe (ohne Abzüge)
* Kaffee/ Tee, Früchte und Snacks stehen frei zur Verfügung
* guter öV-Anschluss und weniger als 30min vom Bahnhof Bern entfernt
* kostenlose Parkmöglichkeiten, Aufenthaltsraum und Ruheraum für die Mitarbeitenden
